question: What becomes of a follower of the higher teaching who abandons faith through doubt?
premises: A person may belong to the higher teaching.
That person may abandon faith in it because of doubt.
Even when going to the associated abode, such a person gains no fruit.
inference: Association with a higher teaching is ineffective if faith in it collapses into doubt.
uncertainties: āyatanaṃ may refer to a post-death abode or to the sacred locus associated with that teaching.
plain_english: If someone who follows the higher teaching abandons faith in it through doubt, then even when going to its abode he obtains no fruit at all.
